sources.name: Türkiye Fulbright Eğitim Komisyonu
sources.manual_intake_reason: S66 Phase A re-investigation (2026-09-28): the /burs/3 page itself is a static programme description, confirmed unchanged. Checked the site's actual news surface (/haberler) as a candidate instead: it IS a real, dated list page (HTTP 200, static HTML, no bot-wall) but its content is overwhelmingly event/orientation recaps ("ABD'ye Gidiş Öncesi Oryantasyonu", workshop recaps) rather than new-call announcements, with no visible per-item dates in the listing itself (dates would require a per-article page visit). Automating it now would risk either missing real new-cycle announcements in the noise or producing high false-positive volume even with include_keywords filtering. Stays MANUAL_INTAKE -- a real fix here is per-article date extraction plus a stricter positive-signal gate (similar to the abroad-source ABROAD_OPPORTUNITY_SIGNAL_KEYWORDS pattern from S49), which is a bigger change than this pass's scope.

sources.name: DAAD Scholarships
sources.manual_intake_reason: S66 Phase A re-investigation (2026-09-28): confirmed via WebFetch + a live radar.fetchers.fetch() canary against the actual scholarship-database URL (www2.daad.de/.../21148-scholarship-database/) -- the static HTML response (HTTP 200, 2050 chars) is only the search FORM/filters page ("Refine your selection", country/subject dropdowns); the '151 Scholarship options' result listing itself is loaded dynamically (JS/AJAX), not present in the fetched HTML. A list-page fetcher here would perpetually see only the unchanging form page and never the real results -- worse than not automating, since it would report HEALTHY while producing zero real signal. Stays MANUAL_INTAKE; a real fix would require finding DAAD's underlying search/results API (not discoverable via a plain page fetch) or accepting a headless-browser fetch (adds real operational cost/risk, not done in this pass).

sources.name: Chevening Scholarships
sources.activation_note: S66 Phase A (2026-09-28): verified live -- HTTP 200, no bot-wall, real server-rendered text via radar.fetchers.fetch() canary (no browser_fetcher needed). Country page (/scholarships/turkey/) confirmed to carry the actual actionable content: 'Open for applications until 6 October 2026, at 11:00 (UTC)'. Single stable annual programme page (not a news list) -- dedup runs on content_hash of the whole page, so a real change (cycle opens/closes, deadline updates) is what triggers a new candidate, not per-item links. Weekly cadence (poll_minutes unchanged at 10080) since this is an annual-cycle page, not a daily news index -- an open-application-window daily cadence bump is a reasonable future refinement, not done in this pass.

fetch_plan.notes: Verified 2026-09-28: HTTP 200, 2091 chars extracted from /scholarships/turkey/, real dated content present ('Open for applications until 6 October 2026, at 11:00 (UTC)').
